svg.title: Fig. S3 ThermoRoute PRE model and calibration architecture
svg.desc: A four-column schematic shows the strictly checked seven-variable input contract, WLEVEL exclusion, construction-buffer/router/TCN distinctions, learned proposal and mixture, separate point/quantile/event heads, the anchor-bound bounded-correction tanh schematic (relocated from Figure 1b) with its A+/-delta envelope and non-safety warning, and the final CQR interval and Platt probability outputs.
